units.body_md: [Meteora's Season 2 claim window](https://cryptoworldheadline.com/airdrop-declare-meteora-deadline-ends-october-21-2/) closes tomorrow, October 21, and unclaimed MET won't sit idle: anything left behind goes to the eligible wallets that did claim, not back to the project. The bar is 100,000 points and a minimum allocation of 10 MET, so anyone who supplied liquidity to Meteora pools between July 2025 and June 2026 should check each wallet they used before the window shuts.
